verses.original: Ἀδελφοί μὲν ἐμῆς τῆς καρδίας ἡ εὐδοκία καὶ ἡ δέησις πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν εἰς σωτηρίαν
verses.transliteration: Adelphoi men emēs tēs kardias hē eudokia kai hē deēsis pros ton Theon hyper autōn eis sōtērian
verses.literal: Brothers - my - heart’s - desire and - prayer to - God for [the Israelites] [is] for [their] salvation

verses.original: γὰρ μαρτυρῶ αὐτοῖς ὅτι ἔχουσιν ζῆλον Θεοῦ ἀλλ’ οὐ κατ’ ἐπίγνωσιν
verses.transliteration: gar martyrō autois hoti echousin zēlon Theou all’ ou kat’ epignōsin
verses.literal: For I testify about them that they are zealous for God but not on the basis of knowledge

verses.original: γὰρ ἀγνοοῦντες τὴν τοῦ Θεοῦ δικαιοσύνην καὶ ζητοῦντες στῆσαι τὴν ἰδίαν δικαιοσύνην οὐχ ὑπετάγησαν τῇ τοῦ Θεοῦ δικαιοσύνῃ
verses.transliteration: gar agnoountes tēn tou Theou dikaiosynēn kai zētountes stēsai tēn idian dikaiosynēn ouch hypetagēsan tē tou Theou dikaiosynē
verses.literal: Because they were ignorant - - of God’s righteousness and sought to establish [their] own - vvv they did not submit to - God’s righteousness

verses.original: γὰρ Χριστὸς τέλος νόμου εἰς δικαιοσύνην παντὶ τῷ πιστεύοντι
verses.transliteration: gar Christos telos nomou eis dikaiosynēn panti tō pisteuonti
verses.literal: For Christ [is] [the] end of the law to bring righteousness to everyone who believes

verses.original: γὰρ ὅτι τὴν δικαιοσύνην τὴν ἐκ τοῦ νόμου Μωϋσῆς γράφει ὅτι Ὁ ἄνθρωπος ποιήσας αὐτὰ ζήσεται ἐν αὐτῇ
verses.transliteration: gar hoti tēn dikaiosynēn tēn ek tou nomou Mōusēs graphei hoti Ho anthrōpos poiēsas auta zēsetai en autē
verses.literal: For - concerning the righteousness that is by the law Moses writes - The man [who] does these things will live by them

verses.original: δὲ ἡ δικαιοσύνη ἐκ πίστεως λέγει οὕτως Μὴ εἴπῃς ἐν σου τῇ καρδίᾳ Τίς ἀναβήσεται εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν τοῦτ’ ἔστιν καταγαγεῖν Χριστὸν
verses.transliteration: de hē dikaiosynē ek pisteōs legei houtōs Mē eipēs en sou tē kardia Tis anabēsetai eis ton ouranon tout’ estin katagagein Christon
verses.literal: But the righteousness that is by faith says - vvv Do not say in your - heart Who will ascend into - heaven (that is to bring Christ down . . .

verses.original: ἤ Τίς καταβήσεται εἰς τὴν ἄβυσσον τοῦτ’ ἔστιν ἀναγαγεῖν Χριστὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: ē Tis katabēsetai eis tēn abysson tout’ estin anagagein Christon ek nekrōn
verses.literal: or Who will descend into the Abyss (that is to bring Christ up from [the] dead

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ τί λέγει τὸ ῥῆμά ἐστιν Ἐγγύς σου ἐν σου τῷ στόματί καὶ ἐν σου τῇ καρδίᾳ τοῦτ’ ἔστιν τὸ ῥῆμα τῆς πίστεως ὃ κηρύσσομεν
verses.transliteration: Alla ti legei to rhēma estin Engys sou en sou tō stomati kai en sou tē kardia tout’ estin to rhēma tēs pisteōs ho kēryssomen
verses.literal: But what does it say The word is near you [it is] in your - mouth and in your - heart that is the word - of faith - we are proclaiming

verses.original: ὅτι ἐὰν ὁμολογήσῃς ἐν σου τῷ στόματί Ἰησοῦν Κύριον καὶ πιστεύσῃς ἐν σου τῇ καρδίᾳ ὅτι ὁ Θεὸς ἤγειρεν αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν σωθήσῃ
verses.transliteration: hoti ean homologēsēs en sou tō stomati Iēsoun Kyrion kai pisteusēs en sou tē kardia hoti ho Theos ēgeiren auton ek nekrōn sōthēsē
verses.literal: that if you confess with your - mouth Jesus [is] Lord and believe in your - heart that - God raised Him from [the] dead you will be saved

verses.original: γὰρ καρδίᾳ πιστεύεται εἰς δικαιοσύνην δὲ στόματι ὁμολογεῖται εἰς σωτηρίαν
verses.transliteration: gar kardia pisteuetai eis dikaiosynēn de stomati homologeitai eis sōtērian
verses.literal: For with [your] heart [you] believe [and are] justified and with [your] mouth [you] confess [and are] saved

verses.original: γὰρ ἡ γραφή Λέγει Πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων ἐπ’ αὐτῷ οὐ καταισχυνθήσεται
verses.transliteration: gar hē graphē Legei Pas ho pisteuōn ep’ autō ou kataischynthēsetai
verses.literal: [It is] just as the Scripture says Anyone who believes in Him will never be put to shame

verses.original: γάρ ἐστιν οὐ διαστολὴ τε Ἰουδαίου καὶ Ἕλληνος γὰρ ὁ αὐτὸς Κύριος πάντων πλουτῶν εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἐπικαλουμένους αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: gar estin ou diastolē te Ioudaiou kai Hellēnos gar ho autos Kyrios pantōn ploutōn eis pantas tous epikaloumenous auton
verses.literal: For there is no difference between Jew and Greek - The same Lord [is Lord] of all [and] gives richly to all who call on Him

verses.original: γὰρ Πᾶς ὃς ἂν ἐπικαλέσηται τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου σωθήσεται
verses.transliteration: gar Pas hos an epikalesētai to onoma Kyriou sōthēsetai
verses.literal: for Everyone who . . . . . . calls on the name of [the] Lord will be saved

verses.original: Πῶς οὖν ἐπικαλέσωνται εἰς ὃν οὐκ ἐπίστευσαν δὲ πῶς πιστεύσωσιν οὗ οὐκ ἤκουσαν δὲ πῶς ἀκούσωσιν χωρὶς κηρύσσοντος
verses.transliteration: Pōs oun epikalesōntai eis hon ouk episteusan de pōs pisteusōsin hou ouk ēkousan de pōs akousōsin chōris kēryssontos
verses.literal: How then can they call on [the One] vvv in whom they have not believed And how can they believe in [the One] of whom vvv they have not heard And how can they hear without [someone] to preach

verses.original: δὲ πῶς κηρύξωσιν ἐὰν μὴ ἀποσταλῶσιν καθὼς γέγραπται Ὡς ὡραῖοι οἱ πόδες τῶν εὐαγγελιζομένων τὰ ἀγαθά
verses.transliteration: de pōs kēryxōsin ean mē apostalōsin kathōs gegraptai Hōs hōraioi hoi podes tōn euangelizomenōn ta agatha
verses.literal: And how can they preach unless . . . they are sent As it is written How beautiful [are] the feet of those who bring good news . . . . . .

verses.original: Ἀλλ’ οὐ πάντες ὑπήκουσαν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ γὰρ Ἠσαΐας λέγει Κύριε τίς ἐπίστευσεν ἡμῶν τῇ ἀκοῇ
verses.transliteration: All’ ou pantes hypēkousan tō euangeliō gar Ēsaias legei Kyrie tis episteusen hēmōn tē akoē
verses.literal: But not all of them welcomed the good news For Isaiah says Lord who has believed our - message

verses.original: ἄρα ἡ πίστις ἐξ ἀκοῆς δὲ ἡ ἀκοὴ διὰ ῥήματος Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: ara hē pistis ex akoēs de hē akoē dia rhēmatos Christou
verses.literal: Consequently - faith [comes] by hearing and - hearing by [the] word of Christ

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ λέγω οὐκ ἤκουσαν μὴ μενοῦνγε αὐτῶν ὁ φθόγγος ἐξῆλθεν Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν καὶ αὐτῶν τὰ ῥήματα εἰς τὰ πέρατα τῆς οἰκουμένης
verses.transliteration: Alla legō ouk ēkousan mē menounge autōn ho phthongos exēlthen Eis pasan tēn gēn kai autōn ta rhēmata eis ta perata tēs oikoumenēs
verses.literal: But I ask vvv did they not hear . . . Indeed [they did] Their - voice has gone out into all the earth - their - words to the ends of the world

verses.original: λέγω Ἀλλὰ Ἰσραὴλ οὐκ μὴ ἔγνω πρῶτος Μωϋσῆς λέγει Ἐγὼ παραζηλώσω ὑμᾶς ἐπ’ οὐκ ἔθνει παροργιῶ ὑμᾶς ἐπ’ ἔθνει ἀσυνέτῳ
verses.transliteration: legō Alla Israēl ouk mē egnō prōtos Mōusēs legei Egō parazēlōsō hymas ep’ ouk ethnei parorgiō hymas ep’ ethnei asynetō
verses.literal: I ask instead {did} Israel not . . . understand First Moses says I will make you jealous . . . by [those who are] not a nation I will make you angry . . . by a nation without understanding

verses.original: δὲ Ἠσαΐας ἀποτολμᾷ καὶ λέγει Εὑρέθην ἐν τοῖς μὴ ζητοῦσιν ἐμὲ ἐγενόμην ἐμφανὴς τοῖς μὴ ἐπερωτῶσιν ἐμὲ
verses.transliteration: de Ēsaias apotolma kai legei Heurethēn en tois mē zētousin eme egenomēn emphanēs tois mē eperōtōsin eme
verses.literal: And Isaiah boldly - says I was found by those who vvv did not seek Me vvv I revealed Myself to those who vvv did not ask for Me

verses.original: δὲ Πρὸς τὸν Ἰσραὴλ λέγει Ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ἐξεπέτασα μου τὰς χεῖράς πρὸς ἀπειθοῦντα καὶ ἀντιλέγοντα λαὸν
verses.transliteration: de Pros ton Israēl legei Holēn tēn hēmeran exepetasa mou tas cheiras pros apeithounta kai antilegonta laon
verses.literal: But as for - Israel he says All - day long I have held out My - hands to [a] disobedient and obstinate people
